messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: PyStan on Windows
parts:
PyStan 2.2.0.0 now works on Windows.

You'll need to be using Anaconda's Python 2.7 and Microsoft Visual Studio 2008
compiler (available for free download as Visual Studio 2008 Express).

Full instructions available in PyStan's documentation:

http://pystan.readthedocs.org/en/latest/windows.html

As always, feedback is welcome: https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/issues

Best wishes,

-a
